items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: I got Willis out of the band I was waiting for you. Somebody called me.

ctx.x: and start to get away. Whatever. I think you've gotten that touch with somebody. Got to take it with me because at that time you say you need a truck in your eye. I got Willis, Willis out of the band, I was with you. Somebody called me. I think you got in touch with me.
Somebody got in touch with me because at that time you say you need a truck in the car. I got Willis out of the band I was waiting for you. Somebody called me.
I forgot your name. What band was that?
